title: Meta Llama 3 Release
summary: Meta released the initial Llama 3 models on April 18, 2024. The release included pretrained and instruction-fine-tuned 8B and 70B language models made available for broad use.
significance: A dated release milestone in the Llama model family establishing the initial public Llama 3 release before the later Llama 3.1 and 3.2 releases.

verification.note: Meta's first-party announcement is dated April 18, 2024 and states that the first two Llama 3 models were being made available for broad use that day, identifying pretrained and instruction-fine-tuned 8B and 70B models. A separate Meta responsibility post dated the same day states that Meta released Meta Llama 3 that day.
